question: Which stronger claims can actually be completed now while retaining the current hydrogel continuation paper?
scope_limit: This reviews the admitted current records and existing tooling, not a global proof that no compatible public data exist. Previously closed source searches were not repeated.

claims.claim: Generalization to genuinely new compatible formulations or independent preparation batches
objective_missing: Genuinely unconsumed compatible native flow curves
Reliable formulation/batch/aliquot/run relationships and measurement state
Approved future sampling unit, coordinate rule, endpoint and practical tolerance/budget
existing_preparation: SOURCE_CANDIDATES and MATERIAL_STATE_EVIDENCE state admission rules and remaining identity gaps
coordinates.py constructs a plan without eta
freeze_predictions.py records candidate/GP/conditional-Gaussian laws from six anchors only, binding hashes and UTC
CONFIRMATION_SPEC and EXECUTION_PROTOCOL distinguish new formulations from new batches and independent units
claims.readiness_boundary: The snapshot script does not certify source identity or preregistration. A scorer/file adapter must be bound to the actual admitted format after real input roles are defined; no fictitious scoring of absent data.
not_substitutes: A mirror/newDOI alias of the same original curves
A repository archive of already-consumed data
claims.reopen_only_when: An actual new source/measurement record with sufficient identity and state arrives. Then register an actual-time protocol and freeze all chosen methods before target reveal.

objective_missing: Data with a calibration role separated from model development and final confirmation
An approved coverage object, such as marginal positions or the whole continuation segment
A plausible sampling/exchangeability unit and compatible measurement conditions
existing_preparation: Native Gaussian quantiles, coverage, width, interval score and difficultP0 are already reported
One fixeddf10 Student-t sensitivity analysis is already complete; no df search or default replacement
EXECUTION_PROTOCOL section8 already describes separate calibration roles and an optional curvewise split-conformal design
claims.readiness_boundary: No calibration algorithm has been fitted or validated on real held calibration units. A calibration reader/implementation should follow an approved actual unit/coverage design, rather than silently calibrate consumed25P.
not_substitutes: Fitting intervals on final confirmation targets
claims.safe_current_decision: Retain the frozen native law and the honest coverage limitation; do not add another tuned calibration head to this paper merely to remove the caveat.
claims.reopen_only_when: Compatible genuinely separate calibration units and a fixed target coverage design become available. Adjusted bands do not automatically define a calibrated full joint density.

claims.claim: Actual experimental time, material or monetary savings
objective_missing: Actually executed full-scan and sparse-anchor workflows with matched relevant quality requirements
Raw phase timestamps, instrument occupancy, operator time, material use and failure/retest records
State/scan-order and independent-unit mapping, with validation-only truth acquisition identified separately
existing_preparation: The source method record cites a nominal360s full steady-viscosity scan, not current per-run resource observations
The paper already avoids claiming84.6percent saving from masking33of39positions
claims.readiness_boundary: Point counts and nominal protocol duration cannot reconstruct actual savings. Preparation, equilibration, travel through intermediate shear rates, cleaning and repeat failures may remain even when few values are retained.
not_substitutes: Offline masking of a fully acquired curve
A model inference benchmark or GPUtime
claims.safe_increment_created_now: Header-only two-file measurement/resource-event template with a data dictionary and accounting rules. It contains zero observations, approvedN or claimed savings.
claims.reopen_only_when: Real comparable workflow records and quality tolerance are supplied. Report study validation resources and intended deployment resources separately, with all attempted units and reruns.

minimum_author_input_when_ready: For a new-batch claim: an actual compatible native curve source plus formulation/batch/run identity and state, with known prior-use role.
For calibration: separately assigned compatible units and the intended marginal/whole-curve coverage object.
For savings: actual workflow and phase-resource records for an honest comparison, plus acceptable material prediction error.
not_repeated: Historical precision scenarios or synthetic calibration demonstrations

paper_readiness_interpretation: The current evidence can support a coherent, bounded application-method manuscript after ordinary author factual, availability and editorial review. Independent new wet experiments are not a universal submission prerequisite; they are needed to support stronger new-batch, calibration or laboratory-saving claims if those claims are made. Suitability and acceptance remain journal judgments.
GitHub_role: A versioned archive can preserve the current manuscript/code and support later traceability. It is not new materials evidence, calibration or a laboratory-cost experiment.
